title: finding(plugin-charts): a third or later `yAxis` entry validates but is silently unused — no axis, no note, its `title` / `format` / `min` / `max` dropped, while a series derived from it plots against the right-hand axis
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ a declared key with no reader past the second entry (class c), read from source with a probe. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the objectui#10654 dev report (PR objectui#10686, now merged as `4df0f3d`). The seat re-read it on objectui `origin/main`. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here.

## Fact

- `@objectstack/spec`'s `ChartConfig.yAxis` is `z.array(ChartAxisSchema)`, uncapped. So an authored chart with three `yAxis` entries validates.
- `placeYAxes` (`packages/plugin-charts/src/normalizeChartSchema.ts:487-492`) places only `(yAxes ?? []).slice(0, 2)`. That is unchanged on purpose in PR objectui#10686.
- A third entry therefore draws no axis and no note. Its `title`, `format`, `min` and `max` are unused, while a series derived from it plots against the right-hand axis.

**Probe** (the dev's throwaway jsdom probe through `ChartRenderer`, deleted, at both the base and PR objectui#10686's head): a `bar` with `yAxis` `[revenue, cost, cost titled "third"]` draws 9 bar rectangles, no `third` label, and 0 notes.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Either draw nothing for entries past the second and say so with a note (the x/y note channel PR objectui#10647 / PR objectui#10686 use), or narrow the accepted count where objectui owns the face. Which one is triage's.

## Dedupe

Searched this repo with the MCP semantic issue search, including closed issues: `third yAxis entry ignored chart more than two y axes silently unused` ⇒ objectui#10608 (open; `ObjectChartSchema` axis keys not read, a different node), objectui#10654 / objectui#10587 (closed; the side of the first two axes) and older closed chart cards. None covers a third entry, and the hits show the instrument is lit.

Dedupe words: `third yAxis entry dropped` · `yAxis more than two entries` · `yAxis[2] ignored silently`
